professionalSummary.text: Built retrieval pipelines for support-answer prototype using vector store indexing of help-centre articles
professionalSummary.witness: Built the retrieval pipeline for a support-answer prototype, splitting 3,400 help-centre articles into passages and indexing them in a vector store refreshed nightly from the help-centre export.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained offline evaluation harness scoring groundedness and correctness for prompt and retrieval changes
professionalSummary.witness: Built an offline evaluation harness of 600 graded question-answer pairs that scores groundedness and correctness for every prompt or retrieval change, storing results per run for comparison.

professionalSummary.text: Agreed hand-off rules with support operations lead for low-confidence answers and billing topics
professionalSummary.witness: Agreed hand-off rules with the support operations lead, sending low-confidence answers and billing topics straight to a human agent, written up on the support team's wiki.

professionalSummary.text: Wrote Python API service with pytest tests and code review process
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the prototype's API service in Python with pytest suites, with every merge reviewed by two other ML engineers, and containerised it for the sandbox workspace.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran four-week internal trial with 25 support agents comparing prototype draft answers to their own replies in sandbox workspace
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran a four-week internal trial in which 25 support agents compared the prototype's draft answers with their own replies in a sandbox workspace; no draft went to customers.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented pre-release requirements including safety review and support sign-off
experienceHighlights.witness: the closing section lists what would be needed before any customer-facing release, such as a safety review and a support sign-off.

projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the trial write-up, with the harness's groundedness and correctness scores, the agents' ratings from the sandbox workspace and a list of failure cases;
